title: Turning 26
---
<p>I turned 26 last Friday! I was busy so I didn&#39;t post to this blog.<br>
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""><br><em>I hosted a &quot;funeral for my health insurance&quot; for my 26th birthday. This is the photo where everyone looked their best except for Alex, sorry Alex.</em>  </p>
<p>On being 25, and what I did with that year:</p>
<ul>
<li>I finished the longest comic I&#39;ve ever made, and I am proud of it. It&#39;s called the Messenger, it&#39;s 25 pages long. It&#39;ll be posted online somehow eventually. I&#39;d link it, but because of how I format these posts I cannot edit them afterwards.</li>
<li>I raised money for charities as a street canvasser. I have my problems with the field (too much money goes to the canvassing orgs, they don&#39;t have a good way of protecting female canvassers from harassment, etc) but I do think the work I did was a net positive for myself and the world.</li>
<li>I started teaching at LACMA as a Gallery Educator. This is both the most impressive job I&#39;ve had and the easiest. Partially because they don&#39;t ask enough of us, which is a failure of management. But I&#39;ve gotten to show a bunch of young people how to be curious and how to think critically in museum settings.</li>
<li>Throughout this time I&#39;ve been paying very close attention, and I&#39;ve been thinking critically. I think I get smarter every year, even though my brain spins slower as it gets older. It&#39;s not the helicopter rotor that it used to be, but that&#39;s okay. Windmills work too.</li>
<li>I built a happy stable relationship with Michelle. I don&#39;t think my experience of this year would have been as stable, engaged, or confident without her in my life.</li>
</ul>
<p>I have some fears that I am somehow doing this wrong. That there was a better route to walk down. But I think I&#39;ve made the decisions as best I could, and advanced my career or grown my character in the right places. Now it&#39;s about continuing that trend, and perhaps achieving better financial stability along the way.  </p>
<p>What I hope for 26:</p>
<ul>
<li>Pick up more teaching gigs, preferably in a way that supplements my LACMA income.</li>
<li>Finish 2-3 more short comics in the 20 page range. And sell them at cons. Make some stickers and other products too.</li>
<li>Keep reading and thinking hard.</li>
<li>Keep exercising, don&#39;t just get health_ier_, get healthy.</li>
</ul>
<p>The world is hard and getting harder. But I want to hold on, and help others hold on.</p>
